payload.text: The Brennecke Institute developed a thalliline-doped sodium-flow battery intended to reduce electrolyte crossover, a major aging mechanism in sodium-flow designs. Independent auditing confirmed a gravimetric energy density of 148 Wh/kg and established 8,400 as the corrected governing cycle-life figure. The projected stack-level cost is $61/kWh at 500 MWh manufacturing scale. Operation is limited by dopant precipitation below 4 °C, requiring cycling to be suspended in colder conditions.
